latest_pr.title: REC-HISTORY-REFINE01: actual h2/h4 stored-history discrepancy envelope
latest_pr.head: research/rec-history-refinement-envelope-delivery-20261024
latest_pr.body:
## Purpose
Measure the actual retained h2/h4 outgoing histories on their common early-time domain, separating common-node discrepancy from fine midpoint detail. The exact piecewise-affine cell supremum is enclosed with outward binary64 arithmetic.

## Scope and current delivery
S0 freezes the source identities, derivation, 314 channels × 759 cells, arithmetic controls and 30 CPU / 90 wall-second finite allocation. S1 implementation and S2 results have completed and are backed up; their Git checkpoints will follow in this draft. Large survey inventories and the complete raw NPZ are preserved in acknowledged full-stage archives with explicit Git location pointers.

The single primary passed 350 exact Fraction point comparisons, 70 exact cell enclosures and 26 controls. Fresh independent review: PASS_SCOPED_STORED_HISTORY_ENVELOPE. The original physical target remains H5 INPUT_DEPENDENT_UNCALIBRATED, REC-HISTORY PARTIAL, production NOT_APPROVED and REI_activation=false. No new IVP, native runtime, dense RHS or old campaign replay.

## Delivery recovery
The first planned branch creation had no acknowledgement and its cancellation is unknown. This distinct delivery branch starts from the frozen ae189694c15e09c6f96c44ef6b74b48afc2632ac parent. A workspace reset is being recovered from the exact S2 Dropbox archive; science is not rerun. Current provider/commit facts will be consolidated in delivery/PUBLICATION_STATE.json and the final companion receipt.

No merge or activation is requested.
